title: Secured Building, King Sized Beds, Pet Friendly
description:
-Brand new condo in Inglewood (East Nashville)
- Secured building
-Top floor, corner unit. No neighbors
-E-Rose cafe in building
-2 king size beds
-Both bedrooms have attached baths
-Pet friendly
-Elevator

The space
Thoughtfully designed luxury

"One of the best places I had stayed with Airbnb hands down"

"The place was beautiful, impeccably clean, and we really loved our stay! Parking was easy and convenient. Shannon is a great communicator."

THE SPACE:

LIVING ROOM 🛋️
-Open-concept living with high ceilings and abundant natural light
-Comfy sectional and retro style (includes 65" smart TV)
-Barcart

KITCHEN 🧑‍🍳
-Stainless-steel appliances
-Quartz countertops
-Bar seating for 4
-Fully stocked including spices

PRIMARY SUITE 1 (of 2) 🛌
-King bed
-En suite bath (tub/shower combo) also accessible from living room
-Smart TV
-Closet with storage and full length mirror
-Blackout shades

PRIMARY SUITE 2 (of 2) 🛌
-King bed
-En suite bath (walk in shower)
-Smart TV
-Closet with storage and full length mirror
-Blackout shades

House Rules
Follow basic tasks before check-out (trash in dumpster, dishwasher on).

Additional Notes
There is an elevator in the building.
Hosts available via phone/app during your stay.

Guest access
The entire condo and everything in it is exclusively for guest use. The only exception is the locked mechanical closet.

Other things to note
Construction in the lobby of the building is completely done now so we are happy to report that guests won’t have to deal with any inconveniences related to that!

This property is on a main road in the city. You will hear sirens and motorcycles, etc.. We can’t control that, of course. But, we have provided both sound machines and ear plugs to help with that. That said, if you’re a very light sleeper and can’t sleep with any noise, this is not a good fit. City apartment = city noise.
